checked_releases.addon_description: Annotates papers with Claude Code or Codex and answers questions about them (Chat tab, Ask Scholium in the reader) from the Scholium section of the item pane, and shows or hides the tool's annotations in the reader. It also lets the tool write annotations through local endpoints, those of a run in one transaction.

Shows or hides annotations created by zotero-scholium in every Zotero reader with an eye button in the reader toolbar; they are hidden until it is first used, and the choice is remembered. On Zotero 7 to 9 it also provides token-protected local HTTP endpoints through which a script can create highlight and text annotations and child notes; Zotero 10 provides an official write API. The endpoints accept data only; no code is executed.

Hides annotations created by zotero-scholium in the Zotero reader until the eye button in the reader toolbar is pressed. On Zotero 7 to 9 it also provides token-protected local HTTP endpoints through which a script can create highlight and text annotations and child notes; Zotero 10 provides an official write API. The endpoints accept data only; no code is executed.
